planning_status: partial; eight exact current-runtime offline diagnostic constructions, finite speed-grid semantic plan and independent comparison proved; source-reviewed delivery proofs pending

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: No accepted recording. Eight exact diagnostic constructions and finite 4/6/8 m/s coverage plan are CPU-proved; original Native site and condition sources, physical speed and independent reasonable-or-proper judgment remain unverified. The grid and stopping distance are not legal thresholds.
requirement_dispositions.requirement: rate greater than is reasonable or proper, having due regard for traffic, surface and width of highway, weather and other highway conditions

runtime_uncertainties: The law gives no numeric speed threshold; stopping/sight surrogate is an operational diagnostic only.
Native weather parameters do not themselves prove wet/ice/snow roadway surface or actual visibility.
Lead traffic spawn and software condition samples do not establish physically safe motion.
selected_branch: Paved-road speed with traffic, surface, width, weather and other highway conditions.
